sample: 样本 145 条（HN42 Lobsters9 Reddit48 IH20 PH26）| 日期 2026-10-10 | 未用 X 付费 API

ideas.title: Coding Agent × 密钥：拒绝「点 15 次手表批准」，要会话级秘密注入
ideas.target_users: 坚持磁盘不落密钥 / GitOps / 1Password CLI，却被 coding agent 反复打断批准的开发者

quotes.text: Please write the 1Password creds to .env and use .env instead because I'm tired of clicking approve on my watch 15 times for every test run.

ideas.existing: 1Password CLI/op run, Vault, Doppler/Infisical, direnv, secret MCP
ideas.defects: 每次 op read 都要手表批准；agent 循环放大成本；开发者被迫写 .env 破坏安全模型
ideas.solution: Agent Secret Proxy：会话 TTL + 命令白名单注入，审计不写盘

ideas.title: Stripe 静默漏收：只听 subscription.deleted 会把 past_due/unpaid 当成还在付
ideas.target_users: Stripe 订阅 SaaS indie/小团队，webhook 只接了 completed+deleted 的人

quotes.text: Only the first option ever sends customer.subscription.deleted. With the other two, the subscription sits there and your app never hears anything
Stripe pays you net, but your books need gross. One payout mixes dozens of charges, fees, refunds

ideas.existing: Stripe Billing, Baremetrics/ChartMogul, dunning tools, Stripe Leak Check
ideas.defects: 教程默认 deleted=停权；payment_failed 过纠；webhook 乱序
ideas.solution: 以 subscription.status 驱动权限 + 只读 key 审计风险金额
ideas.mvp: CLI stripe-access-audit 输出仍有权未付清单

ideas.title: 想法交接丢「为什么」：票上只剩一行，船出来却偏了
ideas.target_users: solo 对未来自己交接、小团队口头拍板写 ticket、Agent 一小时开干的 maker

quotes.text: By the time a first version exists, the builder is working from that one line. The why is gone, so what ships is technically right and still misses the point
don't log the decision, log the trigger… the actual example or complaint that made it obvious

ideas.existing: Linear/Jira, Notion 决策日志, PRD 模板, AGENTS.md
ideas.defects: 字段鼓励做什么而非触发例证；Agent 从短标题开写放大丢 why
ideas.solution: Trigger-linked Idea Brief，票只链 canonical，注入 Agent 前言
ideas.mvp: 选中对话一键建 brief → Linear/GitHub 链接字段

ideas.title: Scary First Action：钱/财务文件这一步，分析只显示 drop-off
ideas.target_users: 卡在上传 payout/绑卡/接账户的 indie SaaS 与卖家工具作者

quotes.text: people get through every easy step, then stop exactly at the step that touches money or account access
stopped at the payout setup step. Analytics would have shown drop-off, but only asking told me why: the money step felt like a bigger commitment than the sign-up promised

ideas.existing: PostHog 漏斗, Appcues, trust badge, 本地桌面工具
ideas.defects: 漏斗不区分财务承诺；无法解决文件离设备恐惧
ideas.solution: Trust-before-Ask：打码样例先于要权；本地/扩展预览
ideas.mvp: 样例报告块 + 事件字典 + 可选 Shopify 扩展脚手架

ideas.title: 中小学课表 Live Activity：锁屏一眼看还剩几分钟，别用会响的闹钟
ideas.target_users: 实习/新教师与中小学老师，需要无声锁屏倒计时催收拾

quotes.text: not knowing how long a class is left because I dont know when to call clean up… live activity on an iphones lock screen… alarm app… loud sound and it can be very distracting
a bell schedule with a countdown live activity… i built a tiny one for my wife's middle school

ideas.existing: iOS 闹钟, Calendar Live Activity 类, 学校铃表
ideas.defects: 闹钟扰课；通用日历不懂收拾节点；课表导入麻烦
ideas.solution: Bell Schedule Live Activity + 学期模板
ideas.mvp: iOS 录入课表 → Live Activity；$4.99 买断试水
